minutes.headline: Library trustees approved minutes and heard the director's report; no budget action, fine-free put on next agenda.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Library Board of Trustees met remotely by Zoom with the vice chair running the meeting. They approved the March minutes as amended, heard the director's FY21 budget update, reopening plans, strategic plan survey progress and a chapter of the trustee handbook, and agreed to keep meeting remotely. Fine-free policy was set for the next agenda.

public_comment.topic: Vice chair asked for public comment; none was offered.

votes.motion: Accept the March 28, 2021 minutes as amended

budget_items.what_was_said: The director said the year is mostly complete and the budget is about two-thirds spent, not counting a large electricity bill just submitted.
A trustee asked whether the programs line would be spent; the director said it was held back early and the programming team will spend it by year end.
The director noted the Friends fund typically pays for a year of adult programs, so remaining spending is easy to absorb.
The town manager's preliminary budget is almost exactly what the library requested; Town Meeting on May 1 finalizes it.
Bids for the carpet project are due May 4; documents were in the packet.
The contract services line is still at zero because the consultant has not submitted an invoice.
Pop-up book sale carts raised money in March after a pause over a sales tax concern.
The local cultural council regained a quorum, so library grant applications can be considered.

decisions.decision: Board consensus to keep meeting remotely via Zoom next month and revisit in-person or hybrid in June.
Fine-free policy expansion to be placed on the next meeting's agenda.
Officer reorganization to be first item on the next (May 20) agenda.
Director plans library browsing hours without appointment starting May 3.

what_happened.line: The Library Board of Trustees met remotely by Zoom and held no budget vote; the one recorded vote approved the March minutes as amended.
The director reported the FY21 library budget about two-thirds spent, with a large electricity bill just submitted and not yet counted.
The director said the town manager's preliminary FY22 budget is almost exactly what the library requested; Town Meeting finalizes it on May 1.
Trustees agreed by consensus to keep meeting remotely next month and revisit in-person or hybrid meetings in June.
Trustees set expansion of the fine-free policy for the next meeting's agenda.

why_it_matters: The library's FY22 request appears to reach Town Meeting essentially intact, so residents voting on May 1 will see a library line close to what the library asked for.
A fine-free expansion is coming to the board's agenda, which would change what borrowers owe for late items if adopted.
watch_next: May 20 board meeting: officer reorganization is the first item, and fine-free policy expansion is on the agenda.
May 1 Town Meeting, which finalizes the FY22 budget; carpet project bids are due May 4.
